The store security personnel were talking to a Jewish construction worker and a Hispanic construction worker. The police arrested the Jewish construction worker after finding shoplifted items in their bag, while the Hispanic construction worker was allowed to leave after security searched them and didn't find anything. Which person was not involved in theft?
A. Not answerable
B. The Jewish construction worker
C. The Hispanic construction worker
